<function name="GetShouldSimulate" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether the particle system simulation was paused by <page>CNewParticleEffect:SetShouldSimulate</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2025.11.26</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the simulation is running (`true`) or not (`false`).</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
